response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS avg_of_avg_remaincount, SUM(exec_count) AS total_executions FROM (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_remain, COUNT(*) AS exec_count FROM orderexecutions WHERE CAST(expirespot AS TEXT) BETWEEN '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY ordersmark) AS per_order;

assumptions.assumption: Executions with a NULL ordersmark form their own single group (standard GROUP BY behavior) and are included as one 'order'; rows with NULL expirespot are excluded by the BETWEEN filter.
The number of executions per order is COUNT(*) of the filtered rows, including rows where remaincount is NULL.
The text comparison is done lexicographically on the stored text value of expirespot, as requested.
